title: K-Pop Electro Groove (Practice Cam)
subtitle: 124 BPM · Neon Practice Room · Full 4-Limb Isolation Routine
dancer_coaching_notes: Focus on crisp upper-body isolations at 124 BPM. Keep your core engaged during the Intro Groove and Verse Build so single-limb hits (like the Right Forearm Whip and Right Neck Slice) snap cleanly without torso sway. In the Chorus Drop, commit full weight to the simultaneous full-body locks (Chorus Impact Stomp, Full Body X-Jump, and Double Star Freeze) while maintaining smooth tension through the sustained arm wave and halo spin holds.

sections.name: INTRO GROOVE
sections.summary: Foundational bounce establishing the 124 BPM pocket, opening with a sustained Left Arm Wave Hold, a sharp Left Cross Step, and a Pre-Verse Jump Lock.

sections.name: VERSE BUILD
sections.summary: Right-side dominant isolation sequence pairing sharp arm whips and crown poses with precise lower-body ankle flicks and spin steps leading into the drop.

sections.name: CHORUS DROP
sections.summary: High-impact peak choreography alternating explosive full-body freezes with rapid right-arm slashes, sustained cyber waves, and a deep Left Power Lunge.

sections.name: OUTRO POSE
sections.summary: Cool-down groove featuring a sweeping Right Floor Sweep Hold and a final crisp Left Collar Pop freeze.
